list.name: run_id
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY started_at DESC

target.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, payload->>'phase' AS text, 'peer-fault' AS tags FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'metric_sample' AND payload->>'metric' = 'fault_phase' AND payload->>'phase' IN ('partition', 'recovery') ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Coverage — training
panels.description: Training samples only. Missing samples remain No data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, CAST(payload->>'value' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'metric_sample' AND payload->>'metric' = 'coverage' AND payload->>'phase' = 'train' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Coverage — frozen evaluation
panels.description: Frozen evaluation only; no optimizer updates. Missing samples remain No data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, CAST(payload->>'value' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'metric_sample' AND payload->>'metric' = 'coverage' AND payload->>'phase' = 'eval' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Episode return — training
panels.description: Training samples only. Missing samples remain No data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, CAST(payload->>'value' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'metric_sample' AND payload->>'metric' = 'episode_return' AND payload->>'phase' = 'train' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Episode return — frozen evaluation
panels.description: Frozen evaluation only; no optimizer updates. Missing samples remain No data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, CAST(payload->>'value' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'metric_sample' AND payload->>'metric' = 'episode_return' AND payload->>'phase' = 'eval' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Optimizer updates per node
panels.description: Canonical learning events. Update count and policy version are counters, not rates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, CAST(payload->>'update_count' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'learning_event' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Training loss per node
panels.description: Canonical learning events. Update count and policy version are counters, not rates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, CAST(payload->>'loss' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'learning_event' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Policy version per node
panels.description: Canonical learning events. Update count and policy version are counters, not rates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, CAST(payload->>'new_version' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'learning_event' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Peer decisions — accepted / rejected
panels.description: Decision counts in the selected time range. Empty means no recorded decisions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->>'transfer' AS decision, COUNT(*) AS count FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'learning_event' AND payload->>'transfer' IN ('accepted', 'rejected') GROUP BY payload->>'transfer'

panels.title: Peer decisions — reasons and candidate scores
panels.description: Canonical LearningEvent has no sender field. Node identifies the deciding recipient; sender provenance is not inferred.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id, payload->>'transfer' AS decision, payload->>'reason' AS reason, CAST(payload->>'candidate_score' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS candidate_score, CAST(payload->>'previous_version' AS BIGINT) AS previous_version, CAST(payload->>'new_version' AS BIGINT) AS new_version FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'learning_event' AND payload->>'transfer' IN ('accepted', 'rejected') ORDER BY ts DESC

panels.title: Peer partition / recovery phase
panels.description: Recorded fault_phase samples only; no invented partition boundaries or zero-fill.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id, payload->>'phase' AS phase FROM events WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'metric_sample' AND payload->>'metric' = 'fault_phase' ORDER BY ts

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, kind AS metric, dropped AS value FROM dropped_metrics WHERE run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
